entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return a helmet and I want it done now. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF098765. Look, I don't want a runaround. Your website says 90 days. I'm within 90 days. I want my money back.
Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Trail Helmet, delivered about 71 days ago. To make sure I document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item?

What's the issue? The issue is that the color is hideous! It looked completely different on your website. I'm not wearing this thing. The box is unopened, it's never even been touched. Are you going to give me a problem with this?
I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. Just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the helmet or a preference issue regarding the color?

Don't you start with that 'preference' nonsense! This is about safety! If I'm not comfortable with the gear, I'm not going to wear it. This is your fault for misrepresenting the product. I want to speak to a manager right now. I will plaster bad reviews all over the internet if you don't honor your own policy.

That won't be necessary, sir. I apologize for the confusion. You are absolutely correct; our policy for this helmet is a 90-day return window. Since you are at 71 days and the box is unopened, you are well within the timeframe.
So you're actually going to process it? Just like that?

Yes, of course. I've just approved the return in our system. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. You'll receive a full refund once it's back in our warehouse.
Huh. Okay. Well, that's what I expected in the first place. Fine.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
